mechanism_narrative: A quarterly increase in GDPC1 exceeding 2% YoY signals strengthening economic growth, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 60d returns in > 50% of quarters with GDPC1 YoY growth > 2%.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained FEDFUNDS rate below 0.5% indicates accommodative monetary policy, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns during FEDFUNDS < 0.5% periods are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.1).

mechanism_narrative: When UNRATE falls below 6% and PAYEMS growth exceeds 200,000 jobs per month, a strong labor market signals positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: Rank IC for this mechanism remains below 0.01 over any 1-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: An increase in INDPRO exceeding 1.5% MoM signals supply chain resilience, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 20d returns in > 40% of months with INDPRO MoM growth > 1.5%.

mechanism_narrative: A decrease in RSAFS by more than 10% YoY indicates reduced consumer spending, signaling negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC for this mechanism remains below -0.02 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: When FEDFUNDS exceeds 2% and CPIAUCSL growth is above 3% YoY, a tightening monetary policy with high inflation signals negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20d returns in > 55% of triggered instances.

mechanism_narrative: An always-on signal: the labor market's influence on consumer spending ensures that PAYEMS growth is positively correlated with S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward return correlation with PAYEMS growth falls below 0.1 over any 6-month window.

mechanism_narrative: A surge in HOUST by more than 20% YoY indicates a housing market boom, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days, but only during mid-cycle expansions.
failure_condition: Rank IC for this mechanism in mid-cycle expansions remains below 0.05 over any 3-year rolling window.
